metadata.description: Deterministic operator-ui end-to-end seed including governed lesson dispositions.

product.name: Atlas
product.description: Seeded Atlas operator UI end-to-end product.
product.vision: Exercise the live read API with deterministic operational shapes.

acceptance_criteria: ATLAS-1 renders the first seeded acceptance criterion without truncation.
ATLAS-1 renders the second seeded acceptance criterion in stored order.
non_goals: Do not add writes to the operator UI.
Do not assemble ticket detail with other API resources.
implementation_notes: Keep ticket detail composition in the browser.
test_requirements: Compare the rendered detail page with the live API response.
Assert unknown ticket keys show the native 404 body.
documentation_requirements: Update canonical docs only when behavior diverges from them.
Do not write generated planning renders by hand.
definition_of_done: Definition tab renders every stored definition field.
Metadata tab renders source and external identifiers.

dependencies.reason: ATLAS-2 is intentionally blocked by a proposed ADR.

evidence.summary: Seeded agent evidence awaiting system corroboration.
Seeded system evidence with a complete ADR-0008 pin triple.

lessons.title: Lesson references remain UUID-only
lessons.problem: Operator views cannot assume lesson ticket references carry keys.
lessons.solution: Render source_ticket_id and related_ticket_ids literally until the API adds a resolving route.
lessons.outcome: The e2e seed preserves UUID-only references with no resolvable stored ticket.

lessons.title: Promote through the governed browser gate
lessons.problem: A browser promotion needs authenticated operator confidence.
lessons.solution: Confirm the ruling and submit the generated command contract.
lessons.outcome: The live API returns the authoritative ACTIVE lesson and receipt.

lessons.title: Reject through the governed browser gate
lessons.problem: A rejected lesson must remain auditable.
lessons.solution: Require a destructive confirmation before the reject command.
lessons.outcome: The live API returns the authoritative ARCHIVED lesson and receipt.

lessons.title: Expose a stale CLI race honestly
lessons.problem: Another operator surface may rule while the drawer is open.
lessons.solution: Render the server-provided conflict lesson and require re-review.
lessons.outcome: The stale browser never overwrites the prior ruling.

lessons.title: Prevent duplicate browser commands
lessons.problem: Double activation can submit the same intent twice.
lessons.solution: Guard synchronously and disable the confirmation while in flight.
lessons.outcome: Only one live API command reaches the service.

lessons.title: Lose write authority on browser refresh
lessons.problem: The CSRF token is intentionally memory-only.
lessons.solution: Return refreshed pages to the session flow before another ruling.
lessons.outcome: A persisted cookie alone cannot authorize a browser mutation.

lessons.title: Keep ruled lessons read only
lessons.problem: A browser must not offer disposition commands for non-DRAFT lessons.
lessons.solution: Use the server-returned lesson status to bound visible controls.
lessons.outcome: ACTIVE lesson detail remains a read-only projection.

lessons.title: Resolve two browser tabs atomically
lessons.problem: Two reviewed tabs can submit opposing rulings together.
lessons.solution: Let the store compare-and-set boundary choose one terminal ruling.
lessons.outcome: Exactly one tab records one success receipt and the loser renders a typed conflict.

lessons.title: Roll back a missing audit receipt
lessons.problem: A domain transition without a durable receipt would be unaudited.
lessons.solution: Inject receipt persistence failure at the live transaction boundary.
lessons.outcome: The failed request leaves the lesson DRAFT and can be retried atomically after restart.

lessons.title: Replay an ambiguous browser result safely
lessons.problem: A lost response cannot reveal whether the first request committed.
lessons.solution: Retain the command key and replay the exact command after a transport failure.
lessons.outcome: The retry renders the original success and never creates a second receipt.

lessons.title: Keep browser actor attribution server owned
lessons.problem: A hostile client can submit actor-shaped headers alongside a valid command.
lessons.solution: Resolve the actor exclusively from the authenticated operator session.
lessons.outcome: The receipt records human/operator and never trusts injected attribution.
